links.outcome: Model diagnostic score change from public teaching cases to real routine clinical cases
links.effect: Proprietary models declined from RadEdu to RealClin (O3 with images: 1.14 to 0.79); Chinese-centric open-source models improved (InternVL3-78B: 0.48 to 0.75). All models stayed below 1.5 on the 0-3 scale.
links.quote: Cross-dataset transfer diverged by model category: proprietary models declined from RadEdu to RealClin (eg, O3 with images: 1.14 to 0.79), whereas Chinese-centric open-source models improved (eg, InternVL3-78B: 0.48 to 0.75).

unlisted_practices: Adding radiologist-selected 2D key images to clinical history improves multimodal LLM diagnostic performance
Volumetric (3D) frame-sampled input to multimodal LLMs versus 2D key images
Cross-linguistic control experiment translating clinical histories to test language effects

screen.reason: The paper introduces and tests a diagnostic benchmark (RadM-Bench) comparing several multimodal LLMs across 2D/3D radiology inputs and bilingual contexts, evaluating accuracy/diagnostic performance without testing a clinical deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
